title: Jiwa Di Likot Idola .
intro: Lam bayangan eksodus rajek nibak tirani, tokoh misterius nyoe geupreh lam padang pasir. Seudangkan peumimpén saboh bansa nyang ka teupiléh geuék ateueh gunong suci keu persatuan ilahi, saboh cobaan nyang rayeuk that teuka ateueh ureuëng-ureuëng nyang ka jitinggai. Individu nyoe geureubot momen untuk geubentuk ulang keyakinan mandum masyarakat. Watèë peumimpén njan geuwoë deungon keubeunaran, hukôman njang unik dan keukai geupeuteutap. Jeut neubuka soe jiwa kontroversial dan lisek nyoe?
clues: Lon jak ngon saboh bansa nyang ka geupeubeubaih nibak jaroe sidroe peunjajah nyang meukuasa rot tanda-tanda ajaéb.
Watée peumimpén awaknyan jiék u ateueh gunong keu jijak teurimong bimbingan, ulôn preh lamkawan ureuëng-ureuëng nyang mantong na di likot.
Lon peusapat logam meuharga nibak hiasan awaknyan dan lon peugot jeuet keu sapeue-sapeue nyang jipeuhase su.
Meulalui ciptaan nyoe, ulôn peuyakén saboh generasi bahwa awaknyan ka meuteumé dewa awaknyan di padang pasir.
Watèë peumimpin njan geuwoë, ulôn djipeu-ék dan djitanjong peuë njang peugot ulôn keunong peungeut lagèë njan.
Huköman ulôn lam donya nyoe na kheueh hana meusidroe pih nyang jimat ulôn atawa jipeurab, tanda malée nyang ulôn tanggong keu siumu masa.

arabic: قَالَ فَٱذْهَبْ فَإِنَّ لَكَ فِى ٱلْحَيَوٰةِ أَن تَقُولَ لَا مِسَاسَ ۖ وَإِنَّ لَكَ مَوْعِدًۭا لَّن تُخْلَفَهُۥ ۖ وَٱنظُرْ إِلَىٰٓ إِلَـٰهِكَ ٱلَّذِى ظَلْتَ عَلَيْهِ عَاكِفًۭا ۖ لَّنُحَرِّقَنَّهُۥ ثُمَّ لَنَنسِفَنَّهُۥ فِى ٱلْيَمِّ نَسْفًا
verse: [Moses] said, "Then go. And indeed, it is [decreed] for you in [this] life to say, 'No contact.' And indeed, you have an appointment [in the Hereafter] you will not fail to keep. And look at your 'god' to which you remained devoted. We will surely burn it and blow it [i.e., its ashes] into the sea with a blast. (20:97)
